FORM.notes: source note: tati’ingi和tati’ing為free variation，皆表年紀小。詞尾母音i脫落為該語言常見的現象。 | source note: ti’ingee=pa cenana 為”年紀還小”之意。ti’ingee應為動詞，目前不確定tati’ingi中的ta-該如何標記。

S.FORM: aranaikia mia tati'ingipa 'unacikia manu.
S.PHON: a[r|ɾ]anaikia mia tatiʔiŋipa ʔunaʦikia manu
S.FORM: aranaikia mia tati'ingipa 'unacikia manu.
S.PHON: a[r|ɾ]anaikia mia tatiʔiŋipa ʔunaʦikia manu
S.TRANSL: 自從我年紀還很小的時候,我就有了小孩.
I've had a child since I was still young.

FORM.notes: source note: cumacancu受焦形式為cancuun。 | source note: manan和makanan為free variation。 | source note: sii一般表”因為”。 | source note: nimava直述受焦形式為avUUn；祈使受焦形式為avoo。 | source note: ’ekia為 ’esi=kia 經過音節合併後的形式。 | source note: mangucun專指農事工作中已完成某個階段、一部份（如：插秧完稻田中可種植的第一排），必須開始新的一段（如：從第二排開始重新插秧）。若是表整體工做完成，則是用matirupang/marupang。 | source note: ha為sua (主格標記)的free variation，為經過音韻變化的結果。此語言中類似的變化有: tanasa~tanaha。

S.FORM: tekia cumacancu tekia manan cumacancu sii 'ekia nimava manu noo cumacancukia mangucun ia tia matapari'i ha manu aranai kukuca.
S.PHON: tekia ʦumaʦanʦu tekia manan ʦumaʦanʦu sii ʔekia nimava manu noo ʦumaʦanʦukia maŋuʦun ia tia matapa[r|ɾ]iʔi ha manu a[r|ɾ]anai kukuʦa
S.FORM: tekia cumacancu tekia manan cumacancu sii 'ekia nimava manu noo cumacancukia mangucun ia tia matapari'i ha manu aranai kukuca.
S.PHON: tekia ʦumaʦanʦu tekia manan ʦumaʦanʦu sii ʔekia nimava manu noo ʦumaʦanʦukia maŋuʦun ia tia matapa[r|ɾ]iʔi ha manu a[r|ɾ]anai kukuʦa
S.TRANSL: (如果)我要插秧,我要怎麼插秧呢?因為我已經在背著小孩,當我插秧已經完成一段的時候,小孩子會從我的背上滑落下來.

(If) I was to transplant some rice seedlings, how should I do it? Since I was already carrying the child on my back, when I finished one part of the whole transplanting process, the child would fall from my back.

S.FORM: uh makasuakia mamia uh cumacancu uh avʉʉn ha manu.
S.PHON: uh makasuakia mamia uh ʦumaʦanʦu uh avɨɨn ha manu
S.FORM: uh makasuakia mamia uh cumacancu uh avʉʉn ha manu.
S.PHON: uh makasuakia mamia uh ʦumaʦanʦu uh avɨɨn ha manu
S.TRANSL: 我也只能那樣,插著秧,小孩背著.
I could only do it like that, transplanting the rice seedlings and carrying the child.

FORM.notes: source note: matirupang, matirupangU, 和 matirupangi皆為 free variation。 | source note: u’umUn專指插秧完後，為了讓秧苗長得更好而進行的鬆土、除雜草的動作。 | source note: 一般mo’uma（主焦形式）專指做農事，umo’umUn為其受焦形式，專指完成插秧後的除雜草、鬆土過程。目前不確定u’umUn是否為umo’umUn之縮減形式，以及mo’uma和umo’umUn兩者語意關聯是否有規則性。 | source note: 和mo’uma及u’umUn相關之詞彙：umo’uma田地；umo’umoo除草（祈使受焦形式）。 | source note: kangvang 在此解釋為”也”的語意。 | source note: 不同情境中kangvang可能有的語意：都、都是、全部、也 | source note: 此處canna亦為稻田之意，應為由閩南語借詞而來，但根據發音人說法，canaa已成為Kanakanavu之詞彙。

S.FORM: ah nuu matirupangici cumacancu ia tecu u'umʉʉn ngai makasua kangvang avʉʉn manu mo'uma canaa sii 'una cʉn.
S.PHON: ah nuu mati[r|ɾ]upaŋiʦi ʦumaʦanʦu ia teʦu uʔumɨɨn ŋai makasua kaŋvaŋ avɨɨn manu moʔuma ʦanaa sii ʔuna ʦɨn
S.FORM: ah nuu matirupangici cumacancu ia tecu u'umʉʉn ngai makasua kangvang avʉʉn manu mo'uma canaa sii 'una cʉn.
S.PHON: ah nuu mati[r|ɾ]upaŋiʦi ʦumaʦanʦu ia teʦu uʔumɨɨn ŋai makasua kaŋvaŋ avɨɨn manu moʔuma ʦanaa sii ʔuna ʦɨn
S.TRANSL: 完成插秧之後,就要除草了,也是那樣要背著小孩做稻田的工作,因為會有(對稻米有害的)雜草.

When the whole transplanting process was finished, it would be time for the weeding process, which was also done like that, with the child being carried during the work in the field, because there would be weeds (which are harmful to the rice).

FORM.notes: source note: tatiaa 一般為tatia，但此處因為音檔中的說者有Kanakanavu族女性說話的特質，而紀錄下其向上拉長的語調。 | source note: mecara的語意有：陪伴、照顧、保護、看顧。 | source note: macu’u泛指植物的果子

S.FORM: nuu tatiaci ha uh cinancua pusiam ia tecikia mecara nuu 'unaci macu'u ia tia kʉnʉn uh tapinange.
S.PHON: nuu tatiaʦi ha uh ʦinanʦua pusiam ia teʦikia meʦa[r|ɾ]a nuu ʔunaʦi maʦuʔu ia tia kɨnɨn uh tapinaŋe
S.FORM: nuu tatiaci ha uh cinancua pusiam ia tecikia mecara nuu 'unaci macu'u ia tia kʉnʉn uh tapinange.
S.PHON: nuu tatiaʦi ha uh ʦinanʦua pusiam ia teʦikia meʦa[r|ɾ]a nuu ʔunaʦi maʦuʔu ia tia kɨnɨn uh tapinaŋe
S.TRANSL: 當所插秧的稻米已經長大,我就要去照顧.如果已經有了果實,會被小鳥吃掉.
When the rice that had been transplanted had already grown up, I would take care of it. If there were already some fruits, the birds would eat them.

FORM.notes: source note: mucʉmcʉm 專指在早晨的時候趕著去某地。 | source note: mucUmcUm=kia (*’inia); mucUmcUm=kia *(mokusa) ‘inia。

S.FORM: ah nuu nuu totasiarʉ ia makacaangkia aramia'ʉ mucʉmcʉmkia moha 'inia meecara sii tia kUnUn tapinange hau pusiam.
S.PHON: ah nuu nuu totasia[r|ɾ]ɨ ia makaʦaaŋkia a[r|ɾ]amiaʔɨ muʦɨmʦɨmkia moha ʔinia meeʦa[r|ɾ]a sii tia kunun tapinaŋe hau pusiam
S.FORM: ah nuu nuu totasiarʉ ia makacaangkia aramia'ʉ mucʉmcʉmkia moha 'inia meecara sii tia kUnUn tapinange hau pusiam.
S.PHON: ah nuu nuu totasia[r|ɾ]ɨ ia makaʦaaŋkia a[r|ɾ]amiaʔɨ muʦɨmʦɨmkia moha ʔinia meeʦa[r|ɾ]a sii tia kunun tapinaŋe hau pusiam
S.TRANSL: 當早晨的時候,我會很迅速的起床,趕著去那裡照顧,因為稻米會被小鳥吃掉.
In the morning, I would get up quickly and hurry to go there (the rice field) to take care of it because the rice would be eaten by the birds.

FORM.notes: source note: mataarava為”到”之主焦形式。makacUkUna 為”抵達”。兩者之語意細微區分仍需確認。 | source note: aranai nesi mataarava nesa 從這裡到那邊。 | source note: 此處apatarava為表”使”稻米的成長”達到”某階段（亦即呈黃色已熟的階段）。 | source note: mataarava=cu tanavikarU sua pusiam 字面上意思為”已經到了稻米變黃”，亦可解釋為”稻米已經到了變黃的階段”

S.FORM: ah nuu makasuacu apatarava nuu tanavikarʉci ha pusiam ia tecikia maripusiam.
S.PHON: ah nuu makasuaʦu apata[r|ɾ]ava nuu tanavika[r|ɾ]ɨʦi ha pusiam ia teʦikia ma[r|ɾ]ipusiam
S.FORM: ah nuu makasuacu apatarava nuu tanavikarʉci ha pusiam ia tecikia maripusiam.
S.PHON: ah nuu makasuaʦu apata[r|ɾ]ava nuu tanavika[r|ɾ]ɨʦi ha pusiam ia teʦikia ma[r|ɾ]ipusiam
S.TRANSL: 如果稻米已經那樣了(結了果實),已經到了變黃的階段,我就要收割稻米.
If the rice had become like that (had already grown some fruit), and had become yellow, I would then reap the rice.

FORM.notes: source note: 此處cau有”他人、別人”的語意。 | source note: 此處發音人是指只有其”夫妻倆”兩位在做農。

S.FORM: kee uh marivicikia cau nuu maripusiamkia sii tassa mamia.
S.PHON: kee uh ma[r|ɾ]iviʦikia ʦau nuu ma[r|ɾ]ipusiamkia sii tassa mamia
S.FORM: kee uh marivicikia cau nuu maripusiamkia sii tassa mamia.
S.PHON: kee uh ma[r|ɾ]iviʦikia ʦau nuu ma[r|ɾ]ipusiamkia sii tassa mamia
S.TRANSL: 當割稻的時候,我會帶別人來,因為只有(我們夫婦)兩位在(田地)工作.
I would bring some other people when I reap the rice because there would only be two of us (working in the field).

FORM.notes: source note: 發音老師表示此音檔敘述者的習慣為常用=kia指其夫妻倆。因此此IU之=kia宜解釋為”我們夫妻倆”。

S.FORM: 'an tia mara'an putukikio nuu tassa mamiakia putukikio.
S.PHON: ʔan tia ma[r|ɾ]aʔan putukikio nuu tassa mamiakia putukikio
S.FORM: 'an tia mara'an putukikio nuu tassa mamiakia putukikio.
S.PHON: ʔan tia ma[r|ɾ]aʔan putukikio nuu tassa mamiakia putukikio
S.TRANSL: 只有(夫妻倆)兩位工作的話,我們兩個工作就不會很快.
(We) could not work fast if there is only two of us working.

S.FORM: uh nuu matirupangʉci maripusiam ia pariincu pusiam.
S.PHON: uh nuu mati[r|ɾ]upaŋɨʦi ma[r|ɾ]ipusiam ia pa[r|ɾ]iinʦu pusiam
S.FORM: uh nuu matirupangʉci maripusiam ia pariincu pusiam.
S.PHON: uh nuu mati[r|ɾ]upaŋɨʦi ma[r|ɾ]ipusiam ia pa[r|ɾ]iinʦu pusiam
S.TRANSL: 若收割已經結束了的話,就要曬稻米了.
If the reaping process had been finished, it would be time for the rice to be dried in the sun.

FORM.notes: source note: pipining專指房屋外平坦廣闊的地區。

S.FORM: monkia pipining ʉ apari ha pusiam.
S.PHON: monkia pipiniŋ ɨ apa[r|ɾ]i ha pusiam
S.FORM: monkia pipining ʉ apari ha pusiam.
S.PHON: monkia pipiniŋ ɨ apa[r|ɾ]i ha pusiam
S.TRANSL: 我就在房屋外的廣場,曬乾稻米.
I would be outside on the flat ground, drying the rice.

FORM.notes: source note: 此句可有兩種詮釋：(1) 不論太陽多熱，我還是在外面；(2) 雖然太陽很熱，我還是在外面。 | source note: 此處kamanUng宜譯為”處理”。 | source note: 目前不確定marivuvuarU中的mari-如何標記。相關詞彙：marivuarU ‘翻攪’；marivuvuarU ‘不斷翻攪’；vuarUn ‘被翻攪’。

S.FORM: apaco'e nuu maciciin taniarʉ ia 'ehikia pipiniing kamanʉng pusiam mari ʉ marivuvuarʉ ha pusiam sii tia pariin.
S.PHON: apaʦoʔe nuu maʦiʦiin tania[r|ɾ]ɨ ia ʔehikia pipiniiŋ kamanɨŋ pusiam ma[r|ɾ]i ɨ ma[r|ɾ]ivuvua[r|ɾ]ɨ ha pusiam sii tia pa[r|ɾ]iin
S.FORM: apaco'e nuu maciciin taniarʉ ia 'ehikia pipiniing kamanʉng pusiam mari ʉ marivuvuarʉ ha pusiam sii tia pariin.
S.PHON: apaʦoʔe nuu maʦiʦiin tania[r|ɾ]ɨ ia ʔehikia pipiniiŋ kamanɨŋ pusiam ma[r|ɾ]i ɨ ma[r|ɾ]ivuvua[r|ɾ]ɨ ha pusiam sii tia pa[r|ɾ]iin
S.TRANSL: 不論太陽多熱,我還是在外面處理稻米,不斷地翻攪,因為要曬乾.
No matter how hot the weather was, I would still be outside dealing with the rice, and keep stirring it because it was going to be dried.

FORM.notes: source note: 雖兩者都可譯為”背”，a’unUn 和mava不同，前者專指將布袋的提帶掛在額頭上的背法（通常是物件），後者專指雙手放背後，向上使力的背法（通常是小孩）。

S.FORM: ah nuu maringunaci ha pusiam ia tecu ʉsʉ'ʉn na poti tia a'unʉn musʉ tanasa.
S.PHON: ah nuu ma[r|ɾ]iŋunaʦi ha pusiam ia teʦu ɨsɨʔɨn na poti tia aʔunɨn musɨ tanasa
S.FORM: ah nuu maringunaci ha pusiam ia tecu ʉsʉ'ʉn na poti tia a'unʉn musʉ tanasa.
S.PHON: ah nuu ma[r|ɾ]iŋunaʦi ha pusiam ia teʦu ɨsɨʔɨn na poti tia aʔunɨn musɨ tanasa
S.TRANSL: 若稻米已經曬乾了,我就要放置到布袋中,是我要背回去收藏在家屋裡的.
If the rice has already been dried, I would put it into a sack, which would be carried and put in the house.

FORM.notes: source note: nikamanʉnga tia tasʉ’a pusiam發音老師直譯為：所製作的收藏稻米的地方。

S.FORM: 'unakia tasʉ'a na tanasa nikamanʉnga tia tasʉ'a pusiam.
S.PHON: ʔunakia tasɨʔa na tanasa nikamanɨŋa tia tasɨʔa pusiam
S.FORM: 'unakia tasʉ'a na tanasa nikamanʉnga tia tasʉ'a pusiam.
S.PHON: ʔunakia tasɨʔa na tanasa nikamanɨŋa tia tasɨʔa pusiam
S.TRANSL: 我在家屋裡有一個收藏的地方,是做來收藏稻米的地方.
I have a place for storage in the house, which was made to be a storage place for rice.

FORM.notes: source note: tasange為tarasangai縮減的結果。

S.FORM: ʉng makasuacu tasangecikia.
S.PHON: ɨŋ makasuaʦu tasaŋeʦikia
S.FORM: ʉng makasuacu tasangecikia.
S.PHON: ɨŋ makasuaʦu tasaŋeʦikia
S.TRANSL: 就那樣子,我就休息了.
That'll be it. I would then take a rest.

S.FORM: ʉng kong makasuacu mamia.
S.PHON: ɨŋ koŋ makasuaʦu mamia
S.FORM: ʉng kong makasuacu mamia.
S.PHON: ɨŋ koŋ makasuaʦu mamia
S.TRANSL: 就只有那樣了.
That's all.
